comment: First proposal for Tusk-PHP/lsp#431, from runs on 2026-11-27 (Apple silicon). minPass is the count passed then: a ratchet, raised when a change earns it and lowered only with a reason. Readiness, memory and latency marks leave room for slower CI runners (about 3-4x for time, +30% for memory). Interactive features must answer within 50 ms at p95; references scan the workspace and get 1 s.
